integrity: Exact symbolic verification of four-node rational identities, Padé coefficients, and an eight-node integer certificate; infinite-family conclusions are supported by separate analytic walk and resistance arguments. No independent validation was carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exact full-step positivity classification is proved for paths of orders two, three, and four; the theorem gives all-order asymptotic sign obstructions and a separate exact eight-node positive witness, but not all intermediate positivity intervals for every larger path.
title: Two positivity barriers for fourth-order Gauss diffusion on unit paths
